-- Channel of integers with a fixed capacity. `used` counts buffered slots.
type Chan = { cap: int, used: int }

-- A fresh, empty channel with the given capacity.
new_chan(cap: int) -> Chan =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out.used == 0
  post out.cap == cap
  ex new_chan(3).cap == 3
  Chan(cap: cap, used: 0)

-- Non-blocking send check: True when the channel has room for one more value.
try_send(c: Chan, v: int) -> bool =
  pre c.used >= 0
  pre c.used <= c.cap
  ex try_send(Chan(cap: 1, used: 1), 5) == False
  c.used < c.cap

-- Try to send every element of xs without blocking and count accepted sends.
-- Stops at the first send that finds the channel full.
accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= xs.len()
  post out <= cap
  ex accepted(5, [1, 2]) == 2
  ex accepted(0, [1, 2]) == 0
  var c = new_chan(cap)
  var n = 0
  for x in xs
    if try_send(c, x)
      n += 1
      c = Chan(cap: c.cap, used: c.used + 1)
    else
      break
  n
